assets.prompt: Create a production-ready transparent PNG sprite atlas for a cute monochrome Windows desktop decoration game called CornerBits. Exactly square canvas, exactly 4 columns by 4 rows, 16 equal square cells. Each cell holds ONE isolated small toy-like illustration. No grid lines, no labels, no text, no letters, no numbers, no backdrop, no checkerboard rendered; real alpha transparency. Every object must fit within the CENTER 62% of its cell, with at least 19% fully transparent margin on ALL four sides. All 16 objects same coherent style: adorable chunky tiny desktop ornaments, softly shaded WHITE and neutral GRAY surfaces with clear charcoal outlines, simple black dot eyes and a little smile, gentle 3/4 perspective, clean polished hand-drawn miniature sticker illustrations. Strict grayscale only, no color. No ground shadow outside object. Readable at 36-80px. Content by row, left to right: row 1 cell0 smiling rounded minnow fish facing right, cell1 smiling koi with neutral gray patches facing right, cell2 cute pufferfish facing right, cell3 cute wide angelfish facing right. Row2 cell4 cute little catfish with whiskers facing right, cell5 cute tiny crowned deep-water fish facing right, cell6 small round glass aquarium bowl with water and three smiling fish as ONE isolated ornament, cell7 matching empty glass aquarium bowl with water as ONE ornament. Row3 cell8 tiny fishing rod with curved line, cell9 upright fishing float/bobber quiet, cell10 upright fishing bobber showing bite with two small accent splash drops contained in cell, cell11 small friendly bait jar with a worm. Row4 cell12 miniature fishing island ornament with one rock and reed, cell13 smiling seashell with one pearl, cell14 small fishing net collection tool, cell15 upgraded tiny fishing rod with a star ornament. Keep everything intact, centered and never crossing into another cell. Spacious uniform spacing is essential for CSS sprite slicing.

Create a transparent PNG sprite atlas for a cute monochrome desktop sword-growing game matching tiny smiling toy ornaments. Exactly square canvas, 4 equal columns and 4 equal rows, 16 equally spaced cells. One isolated object per cell. EVERY object must be fully contained within the center 60% of its own cell: leave a generous 20% transparent margin to each of the four cell edges, especially sword tips. No grid, no labels, no text, no numbers, no checkerboard painted. Real alpha transparent background. Strict grayscale: white enamel and soft neutral gray metal, crisp charcoal outline, little black dot eyes and a tiny smile on the sword hilts. Gentle 3/4 perspective, cohesive cute miniature sticker art. No external ground shadows. The sword series all point straight UP, entire tip and hilt visible; each with a distinct silhouette rather than increasing size. Row1 left to right: cell0 tiny beginner wooden training sword with smiling round hilt; cell1 simple short gray iron sword with rounded tip; cell2 polished white small knight sword; cell3 broad cute sword with two small notch details. Row2: cell4 elegant sword with gray crystal in crossguard; cell5 wing-guard sword with one little star; cell6 graceful curved moon sword; cell7 white crystal sword with a tiny crown hilt. Row3: cell8 intricate heroic sword with two small wing guards; cell9 ultimate friendly sword with three tiny stars close to blade and a small crown hilt; cell10 a small smiling whetstone; cell11 small smiling smith hammer. Row4: cell12 three tiny magical fragments as one compact cluster; cell13 little ore pouch with a smiling face; cell14 white protective rune charm (no letters, a simple star symbol only); cell15 small empty sword-display stand. Same scale and shading for all16. Keep all stars, wings, objects, outlines INSIDE the centered 60% safe region. Wide transparent gutters are mandatory for CSS slicing.
